name: Render Aérea GP
summary: Convierte un croquis aéreo en un render fotorrealista 3/4 de la casa en su lote y entorno.

source.notes: Template app written by tools/template_apps.py: the workflow is apps/edit's (built by tools/build_apps.py); the prompt below is fixed and "Extra direction" is appended to it.

inputs.label: Ángulo de vista
inputs.default: shot from a drone at a 45-degree three-quarter aerial angle

options.value: shot from a drone at a 45-degree three-quarter aerial angle
options.label: 3/4 aérea (drone a 45°)

options.value: shot straight down from directly above, top-down view
options.label: Picado directo (nadir)

options.value: shot from street level tilted up at 30 degrees
options.label: Nivel de calle a 30°

options.value: shown as a clean architectural isometric view
options.label: Isometría arquitectónica

inputs.label: Entorno
inputs.default: a single home standing alone on its lot

options.value: a single home standing alone on its lot
options.label: Casa aislada en lote

options.value: the home flanked by two similar neighboring homes on either side
options.label: Casa con 2 vecinos a lado

options.value: a full block of six to eight similar homes arranged in a row
options.label: Manzana completa

options.value: part of a residential development with curved streets and a central green area
options.label: Fraccionamiento con calles curvas

inputs.label: Vegetación del fraccionamiento
inputs.default: with aligned palm trees along the street

options.value: with aligned palm trees along the street
options.label: Palmas de calle alineadas

options.value: with leafy trees and green medians between homes
options.label: Árboles frondosos y camellones verdes

options.value: with xeric gardens of agaves and native desert plants typical of Nuevo León
options.label: Jardines xéricos (NL)

options.value: with wide clean streets and minimal landscaping
options.label: Mínima vegetación, calles amplias

inputs.label: Momento del día
inputs.default: at golden hour under warm orange sunset light

options.value: at golden hour under warm orange sunset light
options.label: Atardecer dorado

options.value: at midday under bright warm sunlight
options.label: Mediodía soleado

options.value: at night with warm street lamps and lit windows glowing
options.label: Noche con luces de calle

options.value: at dawn with soft light and a light morning mist
options.label: Amanecer con niebla ligera

inputs.label: Extra direction
inputs.help: Added at the end of the app's prompt.

bind.template: Turn the aerial sketch from <ref_image_0> into a photorealistic three-quarter aerial architectural rendering of a Mexican residential development typical of the Monterrey metropolitan area, {view}: {density}, {vegetation}, {time}, no people and no cars in the frame, drone photography look, high detail, ultra-realistic. Keep the lot layout and house footprint exactly as drawn in the sketch. {details}

test.view: shot from a drone at a 45-degree three-quarter aerial angle
test.density: the home flanked by two similar neighboring homes on either side
test.vegetation: with aligned palm trees along the street
test.time: at golden hour under warm orange sunset light
